name: Stord
description:
Stord connects Claude directly to your fulfillment and order management data, so anyone on your team can ask about operations in plain language instead of building a report or waiting on ops.

Ask about order status and exceptions, inventory and available-to-promise by facility, product and SKU detail, returns, carrier tracking events, B2B fill rate and retailer OTIF, and your facility and channel configuration. Claude pulls live data from your Stord network and answers directly.

Typical uses:
- Look up an order, or map a batch of order numbers to tracking numbers in one step
- Check stock on hand and available quantity for a SKU across facilities before committing to a promotion
- Pull the carrier scan timeline for a shipment, including exceptions and delivery confirmation
- Review B2B fill rate and retailer on-time-in-full by retailer
- Surface what needs attention today: routing queues, missed pickups, at-risk orders

The connector honors the same role-based permissions you already have in Stord, and each network's data is fully isolated. Every tool is read-only except for reporting a problem to Stord's team.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stord to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stord to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.stord.ai/oms/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stord MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stord lists 25 MCP tools, including getB2bDashboardSummary, getB2bPerformance, getBulkOrderStatuses, getCarrierTracking, getChannels, getContractedCarrierMethods, getContractedCarrierServiceMethods, getFacilities, getInventory, getInventoryAlerts, getInventoryByBundles, and getInventoryByListings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stord?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Stord in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Stord requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stord is developed by Stord. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
